title: 004新的机会
slug: 年少情深被辜负他跪了我不要了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“这...怕是不行。当年你拒绝的第二天，校领导就推荐了别的学生去。”

倏然，林萧咬破下唇，鼻腔中喷出一股热气，语气中带了些许后悔。

“好，我知道了，那我就不打扰陈老师您了，再见。”

电话那端，陈老师沉默几秒后说了声抱歉，随后便挂了。

窗户前，林萧盯着白花花的屏幕，直到被寒风吹起一层鸡皮疙瘩后，她才猛地回神，关上窗户坐回床上。

分针缓缓走了好久，林萧的眼睛逐渐模糊，卧室的空间被无限拉大，逐渐看不清墙壁边缘锋利的角，脚下的地板变成了墨蓝色的海水，身下的床变成了摇摇欲坠的小船。

而她自己，则是蜷缩在小船上，随着海浪越飘越远...

直到早上八点的闹钟准时响起，叫醒了林萧。

她揉开酸涩红肿的眼睛时，发现侧边的枕头湿了一大半。

“呼。”

林萧从肺里吐出一口气，脑海里还在隐约回想昨晚的事，她觉得这一切都是那么的糟糕。

但，绝不能就这样。

当冰水洗去洗面奶泡沫的瞬间，林萧的大脑也随之清醒，她用手抹去脸上的水滴，看着镜子里的自己。

几根碎发贴在饱满的额头上，标准的杏仁眼加上高挑的鼻梁，以及那略微带点青绿色的眸子...

林萧看着镜中的自己，心中顿时感到一阵刺，她有些心疼自己，活成了这样。

当指尖触到镜面上印出的那张脸时，她轻轻说了句，“不能再这样了”。

在简单咬了几口面包后，林萧下载了几个当下热门的招聘软件，注册账号。

如今的就业环境很不好，一眼望去，似乎只有销售，服务员，保险业务员这三种工作。

林萧从前在校时，大大小小的竞赛，时尚策划项目都拿过奖，履历在校内业界一直挂名靠前。

只是沉寂三年，她早忘了自己曾经也算是圈内小有名气的新人。

左看右看，林萧也没找到合适的，就在她焦虑的时候，突然收到了一条主动打招呼的信息。

对方是【星野文化传媒】的。

【林小姐，这边看了您的简历，觉得您十分符合我们岗位的要求，请问您有兴趣来面试吗？】

林萧点开对方的信息，看到了岗位信息。

媒介专员，要求本科毕业，双休，节假日福利，五险一金，底薪一万五千元，有业绩提成。

瞬间，林萧感到一丝困惑，自己三年没工作，这样好的工作，为什么会主动找上门？

Page (1/3)

"This... I'm afraid it won't work. The day after you refused, the school leader recommended another student."

Suddenly, Lin Xiao bit his lower lip, and a burst of hot air came out of his nose, with a hint of regret in his tone.

"Okay, I understand. Then I won't disturb you, Teacher Chen. Goodbye."

On the other end of the phone, Teacher Chen was silent for a few seconds, said sorry, and then hung up.

In front of the window, Lin Xiao stared at the white screen. It wasn't until a layer of goose bumps were blown by the cold wind that she suddenly came to her senses, closed the window and sat back on the bed.

The minute hand moved slowly for a long time, and Lin Xiao's eyes gradually blurred. The space in the bedroom was infinitely enlarged, and the sharp corners on the edge of the wall were gradually blurred. The floor under his feet turned into dark blue sea water, and the bed under him turned into a rickety boat.

And she herself was curled up on the boat, drifting farther and farther with the waves...

Until the alarm clock rang at eight o'clock in the morning, waking up Lin Xiao.

When she rubbed her sore, red and swollen eyes, she found that most of the pillow beside her was wet.

"Huh."

Lin Xiao exhaled from her lungs, still vaguely recalling what happened last night in her mind. She felt that everything was so bad.

But, it must not be like this.

When the ice water washed away the foam of the facial cleanser, Lin Xiao's brain also woke up. She wiped the water droplets on her face with her hands and looked at herself in the mirror.

A few pieces of hair stuck to the plump forehead, standard almond eyes with a tall nose bridge, and slightly green eyes...

Lin Xiao looked at herself in the mirror and felt a sting in her heart. She felt a little sorry for herself, living like this.

When her fingertips touched the face printed on the mirror, she said softly, "We can't do this anymore."

After taking a few bites of bread, Lin Xiao downloaded several popular recruitment software and registered an account.

Today's employment environment is very bad. At a glance, it seems that there are only three jobs: sales, waiters, and insurance salespeople.

When Lin Xiao was in school, he won awards in various competitions and fashion planning projects, and his resume was always ranked among the best in the school industry.

After just three years of silence, she had long forgotten that she was once a relatively famous newcomer in the industry.

Looking left and right, Lin Xiao couldn't find the right one. Just when she was anxious, she suddenly received a proactive message saying hello.

The other party is from [Hoshino Culture Media].

[Ms. Lin, after reading your resume, I feel that you are very suitable for our position. Are you interested in coming for an interview?】

Lin Xiao clicked on the other party's information and saw the position information.

Media specialists are required to have a bachelor's degree, weekends off, holiday benefits, five insurances and one fund, a basic salary of 15,000 yuan, and performance commissions.

For a moment, Lin Xiao felt confused. He had not worked for three years. Why would he come to him for such a good job?
